public.text: Governance assessment focuses on whether legal frameworks, institutional homes, procurement alignment, and capacity exist. It does not assess whether these arrangements function effectively in practice.
public.suggestedRevision: Review both formal and operational maturity, including decision records, enforcement capability, architecture exceptions, procurement compliance, incident handling, stakeholder participation, funding authority, and demonstrated stewardship.
